# AARI Work Designs

## Core Value Proposition
AARI Work Designs provides premium embroidery patterns and a specialized Android application for tracing designs directly onto fabric.

## Key Takeaways
- Extensive library of Aari and Maggam work designs.
- Interactive trace tool for direct fabric tracing.
- Expert-curated embroidery patterns for all skill levels.

## Resources
- Blog: https://aariworkdesigns.com/blog
- Trace Tool: https://aariworkdesigns.com/trace
